name: Lobed Flowerpot with Foliate Rim
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；probably 15th century；Numbered Jun ware: light gray stoneware with variegated purple and blue glaze; with Chinese numeral 3 (san) inscribed on base before firing; "Chonghua gong Cuiyun guan yong" (Palace of Double Glory, used in the Lodge of Emerald Clouds) inscription incised on base at a later date
